result.instructions: Tools for Wistia, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our videos got the most plays this month?"; "Move the webinar recordings from May into the Archive folder."; "Add the tags 'product-launch' and '2026' to all videos in the Marketing folder.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wistia data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wistia_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wistia_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wistia_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wistia_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wistia_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show the current Wistia account: name, id, URL and counts of media, folders and channels. Good first call. Data API: GET /account.

tools.name: wistia_get_token
tools.title: Get API token details
tools.description: Show the API token in use: its type, scopes and expiry. Use it to debug a permission error (403). Data API: GET /token.

tools.name: wistia_get_account_usage
tools.title: Get account usage
tools.description: Show storage, bandwidth and plan usage for the account. Data API: GET /account_usage.

tools.name: wistia_get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Show the remaining credit balance (used for paid add-ons such as captions and translations). Data API: GET /credits/balance.

tools.name: wistia_get_account_stats
tools.title: Get account stats
tools.description: Show current account-wide playback stats (plays, visitors, engagement totals). Data API: GET /stats/account.

tools.name: wistia_get_account_analytics
tools.title: Get account analytics
tools.description: Show account analytics (plays, engagement, top content) for a date range. Data API: GET /analytics/account.

tools.name: wistia_list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List the media (videos, audio, images, documents) in the account, with filters. Offset paging only: use page and per_page. Data API: GET /medias.

folder_id.description: Only media in this folder (hashed id).

name.description: Only media whose name matches this text.

archived.description: true = archived media only, false = active media only.

tags.description: Only media with all these tags.

tools.name: wistia_show_media
tools.title: Show media
tools.description: Show one media item by its hashed id: name, description, duration, assets and URLs. Data API: GET /medias/{mediaHashedId}.

media_hashed_id.description: The hashed id, for example from wistia_list_media.

tools.name: wistia_get_media_stats
tools.title: Get media stats
tools.description: Show aggregated tracking stats (plays, visitors, engagement) for one media item. Data API: GET /medias/{mediaHashedId}/stats.

media_hashed_id.description: The hashed id, for example from wistia_list_media.

tools.name: wistia_list_media_captions
tools.title: List captions
tools.description: List the caption tracks of one media item (language and status). Data API: GET /medias/{mediaHashedId}/captions.

media_hashed_id.description: The hashed id, for example from wistia_list_media.

tools.name: wistia_list_deleted_media
tools.title: List deleted media
tools.description: List media in the Recently Deleted area (restorable until the restore window ends). Data API: GET /deleted_media.

tools.name: wistia_search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Search the account for media, folders, channels, channel episodes and webinars by text, tag or type. Data API: GET /search.

tags.description: Only results with all these tags.

tools.name: wistia_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List the folders in the account (name, media count, sharing). Offset paging only. Data API: GET /folders.

tools.name: wistia_show_folder
tools.title: Show folder
tools.description: Show one folder by its id: name, description, media count and sharing. Data API: GET /folders/{id}.

tools.name: wistia_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List the channels (video series with episodes) in the account. Data API: GET /channels.

tools.name: wistia_list_webinars
tools.title: List webinars
tools.description: List the webinars in the account, with their schedule and whether they started. Data API: GET /webinars.

started.description: true = started webinars only, false = not started only.

tools.name: wistia_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags used in the account. Data API: GET /tags.

tools.name: wistia_get_background_job
tools.title: Get background job status
tools.description: Show the status of a background job. Archive, move, copy and import calls return a job id; poll this tool until the job finishes. Data API: GET /background_job_status/{id}.

background_job_status_id.description: The job id returned by a background call.

tools.name: wistia_update_media
tools.title: Update media
tools.description: WRITE: change a media item's name, description, tags or custom metadata. Only the fields you pass change. Data API: PUT /medias/{mediaHashedId}. Needs a token with 'Read, update & delete anything'.

media_hashed_id.description: The hashed id, for example from wistia_list_media.

tags.description: Replaces the tags of the media.

tools.name: wistia_create_folder
tools.title: Create folder
tools.description: WRITE: create a folder. Data API: POST /folders. Needs a token with 'Read, update & delete anything'.

tools.name: wistia_move_media
tools.title: Move media
tools.description: WRITE: move up to 100 media items to a folder (and optional subfolder). Limited to 10 calls per 5 minutes; a 429 means wait before the next call. Data API: PUT /medias/move.

subfolder_id.description: Destination subfolder; it must belong to folder_id.

tools.name: wistia_archive_media
tools.title: Archive media
tools.description: WRITE: archive up to 100 media items. Archived media is hidden from viewers, not deleted, and can be restored in Wistia. Runs as a background job: poll wistia_get_background_job. Data API: PUT /medias/archive.

tools.name: wistia_bulk_tag_media
tools.title: Tag media in bulk
tools.description: WRITE: add tags to several media items at once. Existing tags stay. Data API: POST /taggings/bulk_create.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Wistia
prompts.description: What you can do with Wistia here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_plays_and_engagement
prompts.title: Review plays and engagement
prompts.description: Read the stats of one video, then the account analytics for a date range, including the top content.

prompts.name: find_a_video_by_text_or_tag
prompts.title: Find a video by text or tag
prompts.description: Search the account for media by text, tag or type, then open one item for its assets and URLs.

prompts.name: check_captions_of_a_video
prompts.title: Check captions of a video
prompts.description: Open one video and list its caption tracks with their language and status.

prompts.name: organize_videos_into_a_new_folder
prompts.title: Organize videos into a new folder
prompts.description: Create a folder, then move up to 100 media items into it. Wistia allows 10 move calls per 5 minutes.

prompts.name: tag_or_rename_media
prompts.title: Tag or rename media
prompts.description: Add tags to several media items at once, or change the name and description of one item.

prompts.name: archive_old_recordings
prompts.title: Archive old recordings
prompts.description: Archive up to 100 media items, then poll the background job until it finishes. Archived media is hidden, not deleted.
